name: jira-dashboard
description: Root orchestrator for the independent backend/ and frontend/ projects. Holds no application dependencies.

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm run install:backend && pnpm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test:backend: pnpm --dir backend test && pnpm --dir backend test:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
